Name: Alternate Winter Trees
Author: vnmryan
Description:
I never cared for how the oak and maple trees looked during winter - why do cherry trees get to keep their leaves, but these trees don't? So I threw this together. A content patcher pack, this replaces only the oak and maple trees and is compatible with any map recolor that does not edit the trees, or at least does not edit the winter trees. There is an optional config file in which you can choose to either 'match' or 'mismatch' the appearance of the active and inactive trees.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1162]
